text:
only-for-build-platforms:
    - linux64/opt
    - macosx64/opt
    - win32/opt
    - win64/opt

tasks:
    l10n:
        description: Localization
        from-deps:
            group-by: platform
        locales-file: comm/mail/locales/onchange-locales
        locales-per-chunk: 5
        ignore-locales:
            by-build-platform:
                # OSX has a special locale for japanese
                macosx64.*: [ja, en-US]
                default: [ja-JP-mac, en-US]
        run-time:
            by-build-platform:
                default: 900
                win.*: 1800
        secrets: false
        dependencies:
            l10n-pre: l10n-pre-l10n-pre/opt
        fetches:
            toolchain:
                by-build-platform:
                    default: []
                    macosx64.*:
                        - linux64-libdmg
                        - linux64-hfsplus
                    win.*:
                        - linux64-7zz
                        - linux64-upx
                        - linux64-wine
                        - nsis
            l10n-pre:
                - strings_all.tar.zst
        tooltool:
            by-build-platform:
                default: internal
                linux64.*: public
        index:
            type: l10n
            product: thunderbird
            job-name:
                by-build-platform:
                    linux64.*: linux64-opt
                    macosx64.*: macosx64-opt
                    win32.*: win32-opt
                    win64.*: win64-opt
        run-on-projects: ['ash']
        worker-type: b-linux
        treeherder:
            symbol: L10n
            tier: 1
            platform:
                by-build-platform:
                    linux64: linux64/opt
                    macosx64: osx-cross/opt
                    win32: windows2012-32/opt
                    win64: windows2012-64/opt
        env:
            by-build-platform:
                linux64.*:
                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build>'}
                macosx64.*:
                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build>'}
                win.*:
                    MOZ_ARTIFACT_TASK: {task-reference: '<build-signing>'}
        mozharness:
            comm-checkout: true
            config-paths:
                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
            config:
                by-build-platform:
                    linux64:
                        - single_locale/linux64.py
                        - single_locale/tc_common.py
                        - single_locale/tc_linux_common.py
                        - single_locale/thunderbird.py
                    macosx64:
                        - single_locale/macosx64.py
                        - single_locale/tc_common.py
                        - single_locale/tc_macosx64.py
                        - single_locale/thunderbird.py
                    win32:
                        - single_locale/win32.py
                        - single_locale/tc_common.py
                        - single_locale/tc_win32.py
                        - single_locale/thunderbird.py
                    win64:
                        - single_locale/win64.py
                        - single_locale/tc_common.py
                        - single_locale/tc_win64.py
                        - single_locale/thunderbird.py
            # no default, so we fail on new entries
            actions: ['list-locales', 'setup', 'repack', 'summary']
